from rest_framework.views import APIView
from rest_framework.response import Response
from rest_framework.permissions import IsAuthenticated
from django.contrib.gis.geos import GEOSGeometry
from .models import PropertyParcel
from .serializers import PropertyParcelSerializer

class PropertyParcelsWithinPolygonView(APIView):
    permission_classes = [IsAuthenticated]

    def post(self, request):
        geojson_poly = request.data.get('boundary_geojson')
        search_poly = GEOSGeometry(geojson_poly, srid=4326)

        # Enforce fund boundary check before executing spatial query
        parcels = PropertyParcel.objects.filter(
            portfolio__fund=request.user.fund,
            geom__within=search_poly
        )
        return Response(PropertyParcelSerializer(parcels, many=True).data)
